subject.title: feat(ios): per-gateway custom headers for gateways behind authenticating proxies

question: Should iOS support arbitrary per-gateway custom headers now, or should this PR be narrowed to typed proxy-auth credentials with an explicit secure-transport, reset, and sibling-consumer contract first?
rationale: The code defects are concrete, but the permanent product/security boundary controls arbitrary credential headers before Gateway auth, native secure storage, cleartext behavior, reset semantics, and share-extension support.

options.title: Repair broad custom headers before merge
options.body: Keep arbitrary headers, but require wss-only or an explicit block/warning, full reset cleanup, share-extension handling or scoped-out UX, and real reverse-proxy proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to typed proxy auth
options.body: Replace arbitrary name/value headers with a smaller Basic/Bearer or fixed-header contract that is easier to validate, redact, clear, and document across mobile surfaces.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave native proxy credentials unsupported until maintainers define the cross-platform mobile transport-auth contract with Android and CLI work.

recommendation.title: Repair broad custom headers before merge
recommendation.body: Keep arbitrary headers, but require wss-only or an explicit block/warning, full reset cleanup, share-extension handling or scoped-out UX, and real reverse-proxy proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the feature request and branch, has the strongest adjacent gateway/auth history in this review, and is the clearest person to coordinate owner/security direction.
